name: agentready-v1-sdd-package
core_flow: Upload files -> Convert -> Preview Markdown -> Download AgentReady zip
notes: Designed for non-technical organization staff first.
Build CLI first, then web app.
First local build supports TXT, Markdown, CSV, and DOCX before PDF/XLSX.
No AI document processing, anonymization, accounts, billing, or persistent workspaces in V1.
Temporary processing and deletion are core privacy requirements.
Avoid GPL dependencies unless explicitly approved.
AgentReady credits, donate credits, hosted beta access codes, and sensitive-file mode are future or beta tracks as specified in docs/21.
